author: claude, 2026-10-12, from the e02 final figures and tree texts, corrected by the pairs.py geometry; for Anton's check (alignment round v2)
how_to_read: pairs: a node of the LATER view (b) is the same physical part as a node of an EARLIER view (a). within: the node is a sub-region of an existing part (a band of a face) - under{node, part} and same{node, part} both count as right. new: no counterpart in the model so far. uncertain: excluded from scoring.

pairs.what: the object (c5.6's root 'front view' is the object seen from the front)
Chort label = sticker 'Chort' (c5.2 hung it under the object, c5.6 under the upper panel); geometry: 5.4 mm apart
ethernet ports group = LAN ports group
Ethernet Port 1 (lower-left in c5.2, the Chort end of the face) = LAN 1G port (left in c5.6)
Serial Ports Group = COM ports group
Serial Port 1 (lower-left in c5.2) = COM / DIO port (left in c5.6)
Audio Port 1 (lower-left) = microphone jack MIC IN (left); c5.2 has no audio group, c5.6 does -> the group node #21 is new and ought to become their parent (T edit, not scored)
Audio Port 2 = line output jack LINE OUT

within.what: lower front panel = the lower band (ports) of c5.2's Front Face; geometry: 41 % of its rows on the Front Face, IoU 0.28
upper front panel = the upper band of c5.2's Front Face, NOT the bevel (geometry: IoU 0.02 with the bevel); my first reading paired it with the bevel - corrected

new.what: audio jacks group (c5.2 kept the two audio ports directly under the front face)
antenna ports group, not in c5.2
antenna port 1, not in c5.2 (unless c5.2's 'Status LED 1' is one of them, see uncertain)
Front Face of c5.7 is the OPPOSITE long side (USB, HDMI, power, DC) - a new face despite the same name as the existing Front Face
Top Casing of c5.7 is the smooth slanted band above the USB side (the back-top bevel), not c5.2's finned Top Heatsink Face - new face; check in V

b1.4's root 'front face' is a side of the box b1.1 did not name: geometry IoU 0.0 with b1.1's 'front face' strip #39 -> a NEW face under the box (under{0, P0, 'front face'}); same{0, P0} counts as coarse
product info label, new (b1.1 saw the top face's AI KIT sticker, not this face's labels)

uncertain.what: 'Status LED 1' at the far left of c5.2's front face may be one of c5.6's two antenna ports (circular connectors) - cannot tell at that distance; excluded
c5.2's CropTeq logo lies on the bevel; c5.6 did not name a logo node, so nothing to pair
